d: Dave talks about Foo Fighters performing all week on our show, headlining KROQ’s Almost Acoustic Christmas, meeting Taylor Hawkins there and poaching him from Alanis Morissette, smoking 3,000 pounds of meat for the charity Hope United, cooking for Vin Diesel, knowing his daughter Violet was going to be a musician when she was four, the new Foo Fighters album Your Favorite Toy, and auditioning for his mom when he was ten.
